task_title: Idempotent Nehemiah 2 importer into the existing local Supabase/PostgreSQL schema
result: PASS — clean-rebuild import and all SQL tests pass; data is queryable. Draft/private only.
user_visible_outcome: No app or public change. The four EN-01 packages can now be imported transactionally into private_staging with stable keys; re-importing identical data is a no-op, changed replay fails clearly, and any failure rolls back completely. An import receipt is recorded and the data is queryable by draft-only, private queries.

guarantees_proven.transactional: All writes run in ONE psql -1 transaction. Injected a failure after partial inserts (682 statements) and re-queried: entities/claims/mentions/receipts = 0/0/0/0 — full rollback.
guarantees_proven.idempotent_noop: Second run of identical packages printed: no-op: identical payload already imported (payload_digest sha256:b82b7e57...). No writes.
guarantees_proven.changed_replay: A modified locale package produced a different payload digest and exited with: changed replay: import:neh2:canonical-locale-edition was imported with digest ...; refusing to overwrite (rollback, no writes). No writes occurred.
guarantees_proven.receipt_counts: The receipt now stores inserted / unchanged / rejected counts with a per-table breakdown. First import on a clean database: inserted=379, unchanged=0, rejected=0 (entities 37, claims 33, citations 56, attestations 86, mentions 74, relationships 17, relevance 50, contexts 6, verses 20). An identical re-import prints status=no_op with inserted=0, unchanged=379, rejected=0. rejected is 0 because every record either inserts or is already present; validation failures abort before any write.

schema_changes: private_staging.curation_imports (package_key PK, package_revision, payload_digest, receipt jsonb, imported_at) — necessary for idempotency and the import receipt. RLS enabled, revoked from public/anon/authenticated.
reference_entity_attestations.claim_id is now nullable — the canonical package permits an attestation with no supporting claim (5 of 86). Private table, unchanged RLS.
mappings_and_limitations: Registry source_release rows are NOT created (rights gate). citation.source_release_id is a deterministic uuid5 of the evidence release key, and citation.digest is a SHA-256 of the evidence catalog entry; source_edition_id points at the imported BSB edition for scripture citations. Documented in the receipt note.
English relevance localizations are stored as scope_entity_relevance.role_in_passage (the schema's localization table allows only te/ta).
Event claim links are not represented (no column); event entities, participants, places and scripture accounts are imported.
place_geometries rows carry precision only (geometry null, crs EPSG:4326, component_license 'unknown') because the packages carry no coordinates or license.
English only; the canonical body is otherwise unharmed. Nothing is published; anon sees zero draft rows (test 08).
The importer is Python + psql (no new npm dependency); it must run where psql and python3 exist.
stop_condition: Stopped after proving the imported data is queryable (test 08 joins entity -> description -> claim -> citation -> evidence locator, mention -> render span with ordinal, relevance role text and context sections) and that drafts stay private. No mobile wiring, no publication, no further chapters, no database redesign.
tests_sql_new: supabase/tests/08_neh2_import_test.sql now asserts the receipt's inserted/unchanged/rejected counts, rejected=0, inserted+unchanged=total, total=379, and a per-table object.
